entities.name: Hans Heinrich XV, 3rd Prince of Pless, Count of Hochberg
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Hans Heinrich XV von Hochberg was Prince of Pless (Pszczyna), Count of Hochberg and Baron of Fürstenstein (Książ). He was the husband (1891–1923) of Mary Theresa Olivia Hochberg von Pless, also known as Princess Daisy.
